criteria.name: strand_alternation
criteria.note: adjacent sites on opposite strands, no reference

criteria.name: host_gap_evenness
criteria.note: swga 2.0's `off_gap_gini`: distances between host sites, per strand, averaged over strands then hosts. HIGHER is better here, since clustered host sites leave most of the host out of reach. No reference: it carries the second-largest weight in the one set-level model fitted against sequencing breadth, over 46 sets, and that coefficient sits in a table nobody here could open

criteria.name: convergent_gap
criteria.note: widest target stretch with no convergent pair, no reference

criteria.name: host_convergent_gap
criteria.note: widest host stretch with no convergent pair; LARGER is better here, since a host whose sites cannot face each other amplifies little. No reference

criteria.name: weakest_occupancy
criteria.note: median 1, strongest 1, spread 1.0x; no reference, since no validated floor on occupancy exists

bg_coverage.basis: reach 3000 bp; denominator is total host length

effective_fg_coverage.basis: reach 3000 bp; occupancy-weighted, the quantity selection uses

fg_coverage.basis: reach 3000 bp; denominator is total target length

selectivity_ratio.basis: effective foreground load over effective background load

worst_host_selectivity_density.basis: lowest per-host density; null when any host went unmeasured
